newsitem.title: UK: ScotPower to seek New York exchange listing.
newsitem.headline: ScotPower to seek New York exchange listing.

text.p: Multi-utility Scottish Power Plc is likely to seek a listing on the New York Stock Exchange, a report in the Evening Standard newspaper said on Tuesday.
Scottish Power declined to comment on the report, but industry sources said it might aim for an autumn listing.
They added that Goldman Sachs and Smith Barney would be advisers on the move.
Around eight percent of Scottish Power shares are currently held by U.S. investors in the form of American Depository Receipts (ADRs).
The proposed listing would raise the company's profile further, sources said, and provide another market for gaining liquidity.
Scottish Power would be one of the first Scottish companies to seek a listing if the move goes ahead.
The newspaper said an announcement could be made later this week. -- London Newsroom +44171 542 7717
